name: Management buyout path
description: The existing management team buys the business. Structured per Employee Ownership Journey v0.2's management-buyout path; seeded values are starting points to confirm or replace.

seed_assumptions.name: Management team has buyout capacity
seed_assumptions.description: The working assumption that the current management team can organize financing and wants to buy.

seed_assumptions.name: Outside debt covers most of the price
seed_assumptions.description: The share of the purchase price the working assumption expects a lender to provide.

seed_assumptions.name: Owner stays involved during transition
seed_assumptions.description: The owner's working assumption about staying involved in an advisory capacity while management takes over.

seed_unknowns.description: Which members of management are actual prospective buyers, with what ownership split, is unnamed.
seed_unknowns.required_action: Identify the specific managers who would join the buyout and their intended roles.

seed_unknowns.description: Management's financing commitments (equity, debt, seller note) are not documented.
